channel_name: Los Angeles County - Board of Supervisors
title: Sybil Brand Commission for Institutional Inspection (SBC) June 9, 2026 Special Meeting
description:
The Sybil Brand Commission convened a special meeting to review recent detention facility inspections and address urgent environmental, safety, and operational issues in Los Angeles County jails.

Commissioners reported severe and recurring concerns across the Inmate Reception Center (IRC), Men's Central Jail (MCJ), and Century Regional Detention Facility (CRDF), including non functioning plumbing, unsafe water quality, unsanitary conditions, temperature extremes, delayed medical care, and inconsistent deputy compliance with body worn camera policies. Several inspections revealed significant barriers to accessing clean water, operational failures in showers and sinks, food contamination incidents, and reports of disrespectful or retaliatory treatment by staff.

The Commission approved the Report Back Pursuant to Board Motion the February 3, 2026 Board Motion: Water Quality and Safety at Century Regional Detention Center (CRDF) and Los Angeles County Jail Facilities to submit to the Board of Supervisors regarding water quality and hazardous conditions.

The meeting concluded with acknowledgment of three recent in custody deaths, with autopsies pending.
